result.brief: 提出统一的连续扩散语言模型分布蒸馏框架，含 Simplex-DMD 与 Reinforce-DMD 两种方法，大幅降低生成所需网络评估次数。
result.reason: Continuous diffusion language models with distributional distillation and probabilistic token outputs; directly matches continuous language model subtopic, though no video/audio or world-model evidence.
